prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: The Solutions Architect opening at Smartsheet emphasizes end‑to‑end full‑stack delivery and AI integration. I have four plus years as a systems architect, designing, building, and shipping production‑grade platforms on edge infrastructure. I have shipped production systems end‑to‑end, handling serverless deployment, edge networking, and multi‑agent automation. I architected linkme‑intops, a React and TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers that gives staff a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts.

I built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that converts a business URL into a shoppable 3D demo in about a minute and runs on Cloudflare Workers. I also delivered tycodes.dev, an edge‑hosted application built with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind that uses a Hono worker to run Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audits and pricing models. I designed a six‑stage agent pipeline (intake, collect, brief, config, verify, publish) that includes an automated verification stage to eliminate hallucinated pricing and claims. I also designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that reliably onboard high‑value enterprise clients. Additionally, I engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines that reduced service delivery time by over 30 %. A zero‑maintenance serverless backend I created uses Google Sheets via OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers.

I have not yet taken regular travel beyond local client sites, so the 15 % travel requirement is a gap for me. I will address it by aligning travel with project milestones, using remote preparation to keep onsite time focused, and scheduling trips well in advance to meet Smartsheet’s needs.
I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my full‑stack and AI‑agent experience can support Smartsheet’s solutions.
